'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Stephan de Vos LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephan de Vos]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Stephan de Vos]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light Side|Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
